job_description: The Officer-Billing  is responsible for managing the end-to-end billing cycle for  Inpatient (IPD), Outpatient Diagnostic Tests (OPD), and Admissions.  This role involves accurate processing of patient billing using the hospital’s software system, ensuring timely invoicing, payment reconciliation, and coordination with clinical and administrative departments. The officer ensures billing accuracy, compliance with hospital policies, and provides courteous support to patients throughout the billing process. Key Responsibilities: IPD (Inpatient Department) Billing: Ensure final bills are prepared accurately and completely at the time of patient discharge , avoiding any discrepancies or omissions. Generate and manage inpatient bills  using the hospital billing software throughout the patient’s stay. Update patient bills regularly  based on all medical services utilized, including doctor visits, lab tests, surgical procedures, medications, and consumables. Coordinate closely with nursing, pharmacy, diagnostics, and other clinical departments  to ensure all chargeable services are captured and billed. Work under tight timelines to complete discharge formalities smoothly, ensuring patient satisfaction and billing transparency. OPD (Outpatient Diagnostic Services) Billing: Accurately process and generate bills  for outpatient diagnostic tests, including pathology, radiology, and other investigations using hospital software. Verify doctor's prescriptions and test requisitions carefully  before initiating billing to ensure correctness. Collect complete patient information and test details , entering all data accurately into the billing system. Politely guide patients through payment procedures , clarify billing queries, and assist them in understanding the process for report collection and delivery. Maintain a courteous and professional attitude to enhance patient experience during outpatient visits. Admission Billing: Politely counsel patients and their attendants  regarding admission processes, estimated costs, deposit requirements, and billing procedures. Initiate billing for newly admitted patients  through the hospital software, ensuring timely and accurate registration. Verify and input patient records, admission details, deposit amounts, and initial service charges  into the system. Coordinate closely with the Admission Desk and relevant departments  to receive real-time updates on new admissions, cancellations, or changes in admission status. Ensure all billing entries are aligned with hospital policies and financial protocols. Software-Based Operations: Operate hospital billing software for data entry, charge posting, invoice generation, and receipt printing. Troubleshoot minor software issues and escalate technical concerns to the IT team. Maintain accurate and timely electronic billing records and backup logs. Payment & Reconciliation: Accept and record various types of payments (cash, card, bKash, insurance, corporate). Issue receipts and reconcile daily collections with the accounts department. Maintain proper documentation for insurance and credit clients. Reporting & Documentation: Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly billing and collection reports. Ensure that all documents are filed systematically (both digital and hard copies). Submit required data to Finance and Management on time. Patient Interaction & Support: Provide billing-related assistance to patients and their attendants with courtesy and clarity. Respond to queries regarding billing discrepancies, payment plans, or pending dues. Maintain professionalism and patient confidentiality at all times. Compliance & Coordination: Follow hospital policies, financial guidelines, and SOPs strictly. Work closely with departments such as Reception, Diagnostics, Finance, and Medical Records. Adhere to shift schedules (morning/evening/night) as per duty roster.

job_description: Job Summary:  Bangladesh Specialized Hospital PLC (BSH) is seeking a skilled and compassionate  Phlebotomist  to join our Laboratory Medicine team. Job Description: Ensure  accurate patient identification  before blood collection, strictly following hospital protocols. Properly select and use anticoagulants  and blood collection tubes as per test requirements. Conduct  swab collections  for  Throat, Nasal, Eye, Ear, and Wound samples  using correct techniques. Guide patients on  proper mid-stream urine sample collection  for laboratory analysis. Handle and process  Histopathology, Cytology, Culture, and Sensitivity specimens  with utmost care. Maintain  accurate documentation , including  registering culture specimens  and recording  collection details  (name, time, date) on request forms. Keep workstations well-organized with  all necessary equipment  (sterile cotton, alcohol swabs, iodine, band-aids, syringes, tubes, tourniquets, etc.). Ensure a  professional, courteous, and friendly  approach when dealing with patients. Follow hospital  SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)  and  infection control protocols  strictly. Work efficiently within assigned  workstations, cabins, and wards , maintaining operational readiness at all times.

job_description: Background: Bangladesh has expanded hypertension and diabetes services at the primary health care (PHC) level through the implementation of the NCD Management Model. However, inconsistent availability of essential medicines and related medical supplies remains a challenge to ensuring continuous and effective service delivery. Sustainable government financing, appropriate estimation of requirements, timely procurement, and effective distribution are essential for sustaining these services. SHASTO-2 plans to organize an “Advocacy Workshop on Sustainable Government Financing and Supply of Essential Medicines for Hypertension and Diabetes” with relevant government stakeholders. The workshop will review the current financing and supply situation of essential medicines and related medical supplies, identify key challenges, and discuss practical measures for improvement and sustainable government financing. Objective of the Assignment: To provide short-term technical and coordination support to SHASTO-2 in preparing and conducting the advocacy meeting and handing over its results, with particular emphasis on estimating requirements and budget needs for essential medicines and related medical supplies for hypertension and diabetes, and identifying practical, government-led follow-up actions. * Scope of Work and Key Tasks: 1. Data Compilation and Rapid Situation Analysis Conduct a rapid review and compilation of existing information covering the entire country on the number of patients registered in the national NCD information system, current service utilization and projected demand, lists of essential medicines and related medical supplies, their availability, procurement and distribution, current budgets, and funding sources. Identify key data gaps and document data sources, definitions, reporting periods, and limitations. 2. Quantification and Cost Estimation of Essential Medicines and Related Medical Supplies Estimate annual requirements and associated costs for essential hypertension and diabetes medicines and related medical supplies for NCD Corners at all Upazila Health Complexes (UzHCs) nationwide, based on approved treatment protocols, patient numbers, current service utilization, projected demand, and available unit prices. 3. Financing, Procurement, and Gap Assessment Review current government budget allocations, funding sources, procurement and supply arrangements, and institutional responsibilities for essential medicines and related medical supplies. Compare estimated annual costs with available budgets to identify funding gaps. Identify key challenges and possible measures to incorporate the required costs into regular government budgeting and procurement planning. 4. Stakeholder Consultation and Meeting Preparation: Consult relevant officials from MOHFW, DGHS, CMSD, and EDCL (as appropriate), in coordination with SHASTO-2 and relevant government counterparts. Prepare the meeting agenda, technical brief, analytical tables, presentation slides, discussion points, and a draft action plan. Support coordination of invitations and meeting logistics; administrative arrangements will remain the responsibility of SHASTO-2. 5. Meeting Support and Handover Present analytical findings as agreed with SHASTO-2 and facilitate technical discussions during the advocacy meeting. Summarize key discussions, recommendations, agreements, and outstanding issues in a concise meeting report. Identify necessary follow-up actions and hand over the report and relevant materials to SHASTO-2 project staff for further coordination and implementation. Deliverables:     Progress Updates Provide brief progress updates to the SHASTO-2 team at key stages of the assignment, including preliminary findings and cost estimates, for review and feedback.     Meeting Package Prepare a meeting package including the situation analysis, cost estimates, technical brief, agenda, and presentation slides.     Final Workshop Report Prepare a concise meeting report and final analytical materials, including proposed follow-up actions.
